title: Scripture and Covenant
definition: Scripture and covenant belong together because God's Word reveals His covenant promises, commands, faithfulness, and saving relationship with His people.
summary: The Bible shows God faithfully relating to His people through covenant promise and fulfillment.
christFocus: Jesus is the mediator of the new covenant, securing forgiveness and relationship with God through His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Covenant is one of the major themes of Scripture. God binds Himself by promise, reveals His faithfulness, calls for trust and obedience, and moves His redemptive plan forward.

The covenants of Scripture prepare for and find fulfillment in Christ. The new covenant brings forgiveness, a changed heart, and the knowledge of God through the saving work of Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Without covenant, readers can miss the faithfulness and structure of God's redemptive story. Scripture and covenant matters because it helps believers see God's promises fulfilled in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with attention to God's promises and covenant faithfulness. Let the new covenant deepen gratitude for forgiveness and confidence in God's unbreakable grace.
